node.title: Official exact-slice t-null extras budget
node.statement: At every official exact-list corridor row, with agreement numerator A, code dimension K=rho N, and t_XR=A-K defined by t_XR log2(q)>=log2 binom(N,N-K-t_XR)+128, prove that the total non-coset-union t_XR-null blocks and unpriced trade families consumed by the u2c/x4 direct column are at most N^3=2^123 after the named quotient, dihedral, boundary, and rate-dependent near-tail classes are removed. The proved near-tail theorem pays 15,14,13,12 layers at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16, so the unpaid half-band begins at t_XR+16,t_XR+15,t_XR+14,t_XR+13. The proved route cut shows t_XR log2|F_p(mu_N)|<N on every official row, so the generated-field-guarded full-subset F2 terminal is not a proof of this statement. A direct fixed-slice census/payment or a proved replacement of the consumer guard is required.
node.falsifier: An official corridor row and certified post-strip exact-slice census with more than N^3 non-coset-union t_XR-null blocks plus unpriced trade families.
